newsitem.title: UK: Japan's NHK to feature BBC programmes.
newsitem.headline: Japan's NHK to feature BBC programmes.

text.p: Japanese satellite channel BS-2, run by the Japan Broadcasting Corp (NHK), is to show a weekly slot of programming supplied by the BBC, BBC Worldwide Television said on Thursday.
An inital six month agreement involves the delivery of 45 minutes of BBC programming to millions of Japanese viewers each week starting October 6.
The BBC will suply factual and scientific documentary programming but hopes that the agreement will later be extended to cover drama.
The deal is the first major fruit of a BBC-NHK cooperation agreement signed in April.
BBC Worldwide is the commercial arm of the BBC, an organisation that is funded mainly through a licence fee payable by all television owners.
The BBC is seeking to grow its commercial income to help fund its expansion as the number of television channels multiplies with the advent of digital technology.
